Team — quick ask. Sam Hart (resume attached) is scheduled for our final onsite loop on Wed, May 20 (09:00–12:30 PT). Grace just flagged she has a client escalation and needs to drop her 09:45–10:30 slot.

We need a short-term cover or a swap so we don't lose continuity for the candidate. Options I see:
- Someone pick up Grace's 09:45–10:30 technical design slot (30–45 min deep dive).
- Split the slot into two shorter touchpoints and have two interviewers tag-team (e.g., design + systems).
- Move the loop earlier/later by 30–45 mins (candidate is flexible but we should avoid shipping windows that break other interviewers).

Please reply with availability now (cc'ing Logan to help coordinate calendar). I've attached Sam's resume and the loop matrix. If you can cover, call out which area you'd own (system design, infra trade-offs, reliability). If no one can, we will escalate to the on-call interviewer pool, but would prefer an experienced panelist.

Thanks — Jordan
